meta.description: Add WhatsApp Business Cloud API channel via Chat SDK. Official Meta API.

copy.tagline: 用 Chat SDK 接入 WhatsApp 官方消息通道
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发需要接入 WhatsApp 消息的应用。
copy.tagline_en: Add WhatsApp Business Cloud API channel via Chat SDK
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building a chat app that needs WhatsApp messaging.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把 WhatsApp Cloud 适配器复制进 src/channels/ 并注册、装好固定版本的依赖,再跑构建和注册测试。它随后提示你粘贴 Meta 的四项凭据,写进 .env。
howto.when: 当你要求添加 WhatsApp Business Cloud API 渠道时触发;如果你正在跑 /setup,它会先回到该流程。

say.text: 帮我接入 WhatsApp Cloud API 渠道
say.note: 会复制适配器、装依赖并跑测试

say.text: 我的 WhatsApp 访问令牌一天后就 401 了
say.note: 会提示改用 System User 永久令牌并替换 .env

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude copies the WhatsApp Cloud adapter into src/channels/, registers it, installs the pinned dependency, then runs the build and the registration test. It then prompts for the four Meta credentials and writes them to .env.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add a WhatsApp Business Cloud API channel; if you are mid-/setup, it returns to that setup flow first.

say_en.text: Add the WhatsApp Cloud API channel
say_en.note: Copies adapter, installs deps, runs tests

say_en.text: Run /manage-channels to wire this channel to an agent group
say_en.note: Links the new channel to an agent group

say_en.text: My WhatsApp access token 401s after a day
say_en.note: Points you to a System User permanent token in .env
